title: Lovely Charred Ethiopian Injera Fir Fir
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring charred, flaky injera bread, garlic, and spices, made into a romantic fir fir form, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the torn injera bread, berbere spice, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Stir well to combine and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the bread is charred and flaky.
Use a spoon to shape the mixture into a fir fir form, breaking up any clumps as you go.
Continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the fir fir is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the fir fir cool for a few minutes before serving.
